request: A carrier plate for a NEMA 17 stepper motor (42.3 mm square body, 40 mm long, 31 mm bolt pattern, 22 mm pilot), held by four ISO 4762 M3 socket-head screws (I have stock lengths 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20 and 25 mm), with the shaft passing through the plate and the motor behind the plate. A 16 tooth, module 1.5 pinion sits on the motor shaft and drives a 32 tooth idler gear that turns on a 608 bearing; both gears are 8 mm wide. Set the idler's centre distance from the gear parameters plus 0.2 mm, and keep a 0.5 mm gap between the gears and the plate. The motor's peak torque is 0.4 N m. The gears, motor and bearing are bought parts; the carrier is one part printed in PLA on an FDM printer. Requirements: The design shall declare the poses of the motor, the pinion, the idler gear and the 608 bearing, with the pinion on the shaft, the idler and bearing on one axis, all axes parallel and the two gears in one plane, without interference other than the designed contacts and the gear mesh. The motor shall seat on the plate's back face within 0.1 mm, its 22 mm pilot in a register of 22.3 to 22.7 mm, its shaft passing through with at least 3.0 mm of clearance, on four M3 holes on the 31 mm square pattern counterbored from the gear side with 2.0 mm of web and of edge material, heads recessed 0.2 to 1.0 mm, and the declared screws biting 3.0 to 4.5 mm. The 16 tooth module 1.5 pinion (27 mm tip diameter, 8 mm wide) shall sit on the shaft with at least 2.0 mm of shaft showing beyond it, clear of the plate and of the screw heads. The idler's axis shall be at the gear parameters' centre distance plus 0.2 mm from the motor axis, that is 36.2 mm (plus or minus 0.05), which leaves 0.50 to 0.65 mm between each gear's tip and the other's root. The 32 tooth idler (51 mm tip diameter, 8 mm wide) shall turn on a 608 bearing that seats on a printed stub of 7.9 mm diameter (plus or minus 0.05) against a shoulder of 9.5 to 11.5 mm diameter and 1.0 mm (plus or minus 0.1) high that bears on its inner ring only, with the stub 8.0 to 11.0 mm proud of the plate. Each gear shall keep a gap of 0.48 to 0.70 mm from the plate's front face, and nothing else printed shall enter either gear's rotating envelope by less than 0.45 mm. The stub shall carry the tooth load: the bending stress at its root, for the tooth force of a 0.4 N m motor at the pinion's pitch circle, shall be no more than 5.0 MPa, on a plate 5.0 to 8.0 mm thick with at least 3.0 mm of plate round the stub's shoulder. The carrier shall print on an FDM printer without supports, lying on its back face with the stub up, with no unsupported overhang and at least half of its footprint box on the bed. The carrier shall be one manifold body in one shell, no larger than 120 x 80 mm in plan and 30 mm high. The design shall be delivered as a carrier STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared poses and the agent's own report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.
